us.title: Star Trek tech catches up with present day
us.desc: This month marks 60 years since the first episode of Star Trek aired on TV, and Dave Malkoff shows how all these years later, the future is now.

us.title: Newsom signs "Jay Leno's Law," allowing classic cars to hit the streets for short trips
us.desc: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a bill known as "Jay Leno's Law," allowing high-emission classic cars to hit the streets for short trips. Adam Yamaguchi has more details.

us.title: Ed Sheeran resumes tour with no openers: "I'm so, so sorry"
us.desc: This weekend, British pop star Ed Sheeran resumed his concert tour in Philadelphia, with no openers, amid a world of controversy. Jared Ochacher reports from outside Lincoln Financial Field.

us.title: Tariffs, inflation, trade wars taking toll on American farmers
us.desc: America's farmers face a tough harvest this year with trade wars, tariffs and inflation all taking a toll. The cost of diesel hit a new record, averaging $6.50 a gallon, nearly a dollar higher than last month. Lana Zak reports from North Liberty, Iowa.

us.title: Trump faces pressure as midterms inch closer
us.desc: President Trump triggered a showdown over the First Amendment after several journalists had their White House access revoked this weekend. The ban followed a week of bad economic news for the president. Aaron Navarro reports.
